scopeLimits: Chrome production content/controller UI on a locally fulfilled X Home fixture, not a live X post.

ASR/model availability/model prepare result/translated text and download amounts are controlled; actual AAC/MSE audio recovery and PCM encoding, actual SRT download event, actual offscreen progress sender/background timestamped storage/query transport/UI are exercised.
No ONNX model initialization/inference; recognition accuracy, native GPU/WASM performance and live translation providers are not evaluated.
Seven locales at 520x290 and 300x180 tested in the same owned instance; these do not establish Firefox/mobile/device coverage.
